title: Satisfaction by the local auxiliary witness
statement: Let $n$ be positive, and let a seedwise three-CNF reduction associate a CNF formula with each seed and satisfy the stated completeness and soundness properties. For any Boolean input word of length $n$, proof word, and seed, if the verifier accepts the local transcript obtained from the input and proof, then the formula associated with that seed is satisfied by the assignment formed from the encoded local query bits followed by the auxiliary assignment selected by the reduction’s local witness construction.
hypotheses_covered: A seedwise three-CNF reduction with its stated properties
A Boolean input word of length $n$
A Boolean proof word of the specified length
The verifier accepts the local transcript formed from the outer query bits
